title: ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Calendar Year 2025 annual progress report on implementing zero waste city facilities and events.
text:
[Council File 21-1208-S6; CD 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Calendar Year 2025 annual progress report on implementing zero waste city facilities and events.
Recommendation for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the Los Angeles Harbor Department report dated June 12, 2026 relative to the Calendar Year 2025 annual progress report on implementing zero waste city facilities and events.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Not applicable
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: The Harbor Department submits its 2025 annual progress report on making City facilities and events zero waste.
